references.description: Denormalized flat join of entity + security.  One row per security — covers the company universe (CIK + primary identifiers + sector + ticker).  For ANY membership question (current or historical, SP500 or Russell), JOIN with index_membership on cik = cik.  The join column has the same name on both sides — this view does NOT carry index-membership flags because they're inherently snapshot-only and single-index, both of which are footguns the index_membership table avoids by design.

entity.description: Legal structure and profile of reporting companies.

sic_description.description: Full SEC SIC industry label (e.g. 'Electronic Computers').  Companion to ``sic_code`` — use this on responses where a human-readable string is more useful than the raw 4-digit code.

state_of_incorporation_description.description: Full SEC label for the state-of-incorporation code (e.g. 'Delaware').

mailing_address.description: Mailing address (separate from HQ) — registered agent / correspondence target.  Often differs from business_address for foreign issuers and trusts.

flags.description: SEC-flagged status string (e.g. 'Shell', 'Delinquent'). NULL for clean issuers.

has_insider_transactions.description: SEC declares Form 4/5 activity exists for this issuer.

is_insider_owner.description: SEC declares this CIK itself owns insider holdings.

former_names.description: SEC ``formerNames[]`` history — JSON array of ``{name, from, to}`` objects.  Useful for ticker-history queries and merger lineage (e.g. tracing FB → META, GOOG → GOOGL share splits, or a former subsidiary's prior name).  Empty array when the issuer has never renamed.

security.description: Ticker symbols and tradeable instrument metadata (SCD Type 2 with date ranges).

is_primary_ticker.description: True for the ticker SEC's company_tickers.json marks as the entity's primary listing.  Multi-share-class issuers (BRK-A/BRK-B, GOOG/GOOGL) emit multiple is_active=TRUE rows; default consumer queries filter is_primary_ticker=TRUE for one row per CIK.

filing.description: Metadata for all SEC filings processed.

superseded_by.description: Accession-id of the filing that supersedes this one in the amendment chain (NULL when this is the latest version).  Populated post-ingest by ``services/filings/amendment_linker.py``.

size.description: Filing size in bytes (per SEC submissions feed).

is_xbrl.description: SEC-declared: filing carries an XBRL exhibit.

is_xbrl_numeric.description: Distinct from is_xbrl/is_inline_xbrl — TRUE when the XBRL exhibit carries machine-readable numeric facts (the source of every fact-table row).

primary_document.description: Filename of the lead document in the filing package.

primary_doc_description.description: SEC-provided label describing the primary document.

core_type.description: Base form_type stripped of the ``/A`` amendment suffix (e.g. ``10-K/A`` → ``10-K``).  Use this for form-family filtering when you don't care whether a filing is the original or an amendment.

film_number.description: SEC EDGAR microfiche / film number assigned at acceptance.

act.description: Securities-Act designator: ``33`` (1933 Act), ``34`` (1934 Act), or empty.  Helps distinguish registration-statement vs. exchange-act filings.

is_audited.description: Filing is an annual (audited) report — TRUE for 10-K / 20-F / 40-F and their amendments, FALSE for 10-Q / 8-K / etc.

fact.description: Standardized financial data points (US-GAAP XBRL mapped to canonical standard_concept labels).

fact_id.description: Deterministic identity hash: SHA-256(entity_id|accession_id|concept|period_end|unit). Matches the Postgres unique constraint idx_fact_unique_constraint. Computed at export time by run_exports.py — not stored in the database.

value.description: Raw as-reported value string, before numeric parsing.  Holds text for non-numeric facts (e.g. dei cover-page strings); for numeric facts prefer ``numeric_value``.

numeric_value.description: The value as reported in this specific filing (accession_id).

accuracy_score.description: Legacy 0-1 standardization-match score stamped by the in-memory resolver at ingest.  Superseded for consumer filtering by ``confidence_score`` (the composite quality score); kept for traceability of the concept mapping.

confidence_score.description: Composite per-fact confidence in [0, 1], populated by data-pipeline/services/quality/confidence.py from the outputs of scripts/QA/qa_layer.sql (postgres repo). Formula: 0.4 * identity_pass_rate + 0.2 * source_agreement + 0.2 * is_audited + 0.1 * (1 - restatement_density) + 0.1 * age_decay. Consumers filter `confidence_score >= 0.95` for Bloomberg-grade rows.

reliability_code.description: Discrete reliability bucket (1-4) for Bloomberg PR / Refinitiv vendor parity: 1=preliminary (errors present), 2=announced (clean, unaudited), 3=audited (audited + clean), 4=restated (audited + clean + multiple versions on file).

identity_violation_count.description: Number of error-severity accounting identities that fired against this fact's filing.  Sourced from qa_violation.

restatement_count.description: Number of times this (entity, standard_concept, period_end, fiscal_period, unit) tuple has been re-reported across accessions.  Sourced from fact_lineage_summary.version_count - 1. Zero = never restated; > 0 = restated N times.

accounting_standard.description: Reporting taxonomy of the source filing — 'US-GAAP' or 'IFRS'.  Derived from the XBRL taxonomy; defaults 'US-GAAP' for 10-K/10-Q/8-K and is usually 'IFRS' for 20-F / 40-F foreign issuers.

reporting_currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code when the unit is a monetary currency (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY').  NULL for non-monetary facts (shares, ratios, days, etc.).

value_current.description: Bloomberg Option-C: the latest-known value for this (entity_id, standard_concept, period_end, unit) — i.e., the value any analyst watching the tape TODAY would see. Computed at export time via DuckDB window functions.

value_as_filed.description: Bloomberg Option-C: the originally-reported value (first-ever accepted_at in the partition).

first_filed_at.description: Timestamp of first disclosure (min accepted_at in the partition).

restated.description: TRUE if any version of this fact in the partition differs from the others — signals that a later filing restated this number.  WARNING: this signal is computed against the GLOBAL state of the warehouse, NOT PIT — a query with as_of_date in the past may still see TRUE for a fact whose restatement happened AFTER the cutoff.  Treat as informational; for PIT reasoning, the MCP server exposes this as ``lineage.restated_in_warehouse`` so consumers know the field is not PIT-safe (audit CC-004).

valuation.description: Pre-computed intrinsic value estimates per entity. One row per (entity_id, valuation_date, model_type) — multiple model types (DCF, DDM, GrahamNumber, etc.) coexist for the same valuation_date. Recomputed each pipeline run; not point-in-time.

valuation_date.description: The fiscal period_end the valuation was computed against.

model_type.description: Valuation model identifier. Live values: 'dcf' (earnings-based two-stage), 'dcf_fcf' (free-cash-flow-based two-stage), 'ddm' (dividend discount model). Filter on this to select a specific intrinsic-value approach; multiple rows per (entity_id, valuation_date) are expected.

intrinsic_value.description: Total enterprise / equity value implied by the model (currency).

per_share_value.description: intrinsic_value / shares_outstanding — the model's fair-value estimate per share.

base_earnings.description: DCF: trailing FCF base. DDM: trailing dividend base.

discount_rate.description: WACC for DCF; cost of equity for DDM.

terminal_years.description: Years modeled in the terminal phase before the perpetuity.

current_price.description: Market price used to compute margin_of_safety. NULL when the pipeline could not source a quote — margin_of_safety is then NULL too.

assumptions.description: Full input bundle for the model — base_earnings, discount_rate, growth_rate, terminal_growth_rate, etc. Use to reproduce the calc.

index_membership.description: Historical index constituents (SP500, RUSSELL1000, RUSSELL2000, RUSSELL3000).  Source of truth for ALL membership questions — current OR historical.  Always JOIN ``references.cik = index_membership.cik`` to attach company metadata (name, sector, ticker).  Filter by ``index_name`` for the index, by ``effective_date`` / ``removal_date`` for the as-of window.  Note: ``cik`` is named ``cik`` here (NOT ``entity_id`` like security/filing/fact) so the JOIN with ``references`` uses the same column name on both sides — see migration 0015 for the rationale.

index_name.description: Canonical short code: SP500 | NASDAQ100 | RUSSELL3000 | WILSHIRE5000.

effective_date.description: First trading day the company traded as a member.

announcement_date.description: Date S&P Dow Jones Indices publicly announced the addition.  Typically 5–10 trading days before effective_date.  Populated by Layer 4 (S&P press release scraper); NULL on rows from Wikipedia / GitHub seed / IVV daily.  Use for inclusion-arb backtests via the ``as_of_basis='announcement'`` switch on get_pit_universe.

removal_date.description: First trading day the company was NOT a member.  NULL = current.  [) interval semantics — a company removed on 2017-06-19 is NOT a member on 2017-06-19.

removal_announcement_date.description: Date the removal was publicly announced; symmetric with announcement_date.  NULL when only Wikipedia / IVV layers wrote the row.

removal_reason.description: merger | acquisition | bankruptcy | criteria | spinoff | other.  NULL when removal_date IS NULL.

successor_cik.description: Acquirer CIK when removal_reason in {merger, acquisition}. Essential for backtests crossing M&A — without it, a stock disappearing looks indistinguishable from a delisting.

source.description: Provenance: wikipedia | ivv | spglobal_press | github_seed | manual.

confidence.description: high | medium | low.  Used by get_pit_universe to set pit_safe automatically — pre-2000 dates default to 'low'.

first_seen_date.description: Panel metadata written by the current-holdings rebuilder (derive_membership.py).  First date this constituent was observed in the source holdings snapshot.  NULL on rows from the historical_seed / spglobal_press layers.

last_seen_date.description: Rebuilder panel metadata — last date observed in the holdings snapshot.  NULL outside the IVV layer.

avg_weight_pct.description: Rebuilder panel metadata — average index weight (%) over the observed window.  NULL outside the IVV layer.

standard_concept.description: Valuein's curated gold-standard concept catalog (~292 rows) — the dictionary for the ``fact.standard_concept`` column.  Each row is one L1/L2 concept (Revenue, GrossProfit, LongTermDebt, …) with its statement/category, definition, default unit, and Bloomberg/FactSet field equivalents.  Distinct from ``taxonomy_guide`` (the ~11,966-row raw SEC us-gaap tag reference for the ``fact.concept`` column): join ``fact.standard_concept = standard_concept.standard_concept`` for the curated label, ``fact.concept = taxonomy_guide.standard_concept`` for the raw tag.  The 'Other' catch-all row is included.

level.description: L1 (top statement line) | L2 (sector-pack sub-line) | -- (the 'Other' catch-all).

statement_type.description: income | balance_sheet | cash_flow | comprehensive_income | supplemental | dei | notes | other.

category.description: Finer grouping within the statement (e.g. revenue, working_capital, equity).

unit_default.description: Canonical unit (USD | USD/share | shares | pct | …); NULL for non-numeric.

is_flow.description: TRUE for flow (period) measures, FALSE for stock (point-in-time) measures.

parent_concept.description: Parent in the L1→L2 hierarchy (NULL for L1 / 'Other').

sector_pack.description: Sector pack a L2 concept belongs to (banking, insurance, reit, …); NULL unless level='L2'.

bloomberg_equivalent.description: Closest Bloomberg field mnemonic, when one exists.

factset_equivalent.description: Closest FactSet field, when one exists.

gaap_ifrs_comparable.description: TRUE when the concept maps cleanly across US-GAAP and IFRS filers.

reviewed.description: Human-in-the-loop CPA sign-off flag.  TRUE = an accountant has verified this concept's canonical name, statement_type and rule; the concept is then LOCKED — the standardization coverage loop only ever creates NEW concepts, never mutates a reviewed one.  Curated catalog rows default TRUE; loop-generated provisional rows are FALSE.

reviewed_by.description: Who signed off (e.g. 'J. Smith, CPA'); NULL when not individually attributed.

reviewed_at.description: ISO date of the CPA sign-off; NULL when not individually attributed.

review_confidence.description: Concept-level trust score in [0, 1] — the catalog analogue of ``fact.confidence_score``.  1.0 = CPA-verified (reviewed=TRUE); 0.7 = provisional loop output pending review.  Filter ``review_confidence >= 1.0`` for the accountant-verified concept set.  Distinct from the per-fact *match* accuracy.

taxonomy_guide.description: Human-readable definitions for all standard_concept values used in the fact table.

level.description: Concept tier: 1 = L1 universal statement line, 2 = L2 sector-pack sub-line.

statement_type.description: Statement the concept belongs to (income | balance_sheet | cash_flow | supplemental | …).

display_order.description: Suggested ordering within a statement for human-facing renders.

is_active.description: FALSE for retired concepts kept for historical fact lookups.

gaap_ifrs_comparable.description: TRUE when the concept maps cleanly across US-GAAP and IFRS filers.

ratio.description: Pipeline-computed financial ratios per entity per fiscal period. Derived from fact data.  Written append-on-restatement: each row's ``accepted_at`` is the PIT vintage = max(accepted_at) of the input facts that produced it, so a restated period (recomputed from a later-filed fact) is a NEW vintage row rather than an overwrite — mirroring fact.parquet.  Filter as-of with ``accepted_at <= as_of`` then take the latest vintage to avoid look-ahead bias.  No accession_id (ratios derive from multiple filings).  ``accepted_at`` is NULL for cross-sectional rank rows (``*_sector_pctile``) and any year whose source facts lacked an acceptance timestamp; ``computed_at`` tracks the latest computation within a vintage.

category.description: Groups ratios for filtering without scanning all ratio_name values. Values: profitability | per_share | liquidity | leverage | efficiency | owner_earnings | valuation

confidence_score.description: Entity-period data quality: average fact.confidence_score of the facts feeding this period. Filter Bloomberg-grade with >= 0.95. NULL for cross-sectional rank rows (e.g. *_sector_pctile).

fiscal_period.description: FY | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | TTM

accepted_at.description: PIT vintage — SEC acceptance timestamp of the latest input fact (max(accepted_at) of the year's facts).  The date this ratio first became knowable.  NULL for cross-sectional rank rows and un-timestamped years.  Filter ``accepted_at <= as_of`` for look-ahead-free backtests, mirroring fact.accepted_at.

ingested_at.description: DB insertion timestamp; use ``computed_at`` for ratio freshness.

factor_scores.description: Cross-sectional factor scores and percentile ranks per entity, computed across the full universe from recent annual filings. _rank columns are normalized to 0.0–1.0 (1.0 = strongest relative standing); composite_rank is a proprietary blend of the individual factor ranks. Methodology is proprietary. Derived at export time — not stored in Postgres.

symbol.description: Primary ticker, joined from references at export for convenience.

name.description: Company name, joined from references at export.

sector.description: Sector, joined from references at export.

earnings_signals.description: Trend-based earnings expectations and surprise metrics per entity. eps_trend_est is a proprietary trailing earnings-trend estimate; eps_surprise_pct measures actual EPS against that estimate. revenue_yoy_pct is the year-over-year revenue change. NULL when insufficient prior history exists. Methodology is proprietary. Derived at export time — not stored in Postgres.

insider_party.description: Directory of every insider / reporting person referenced by Form 3/4/5/144.  Keyed on CIK when SEC-registered, otherwise on a normalized name.  Joined to insider_transaction via insider_party_id.  FULL bucket only — enterprise tier (full plan).

cik.description: 10-digit zero-padded SEC CIK; NULL for filers without an SEC-registered identity (rare individual reporters).

normalized_name.description: Uppercased + whitespace-collapsed name for CIK-less filer dedup.

insider_filing.description: Form 3 / 4 / 5 / SC 13D / SC 13G / 144 (and amendments) — the subject-rooted insider DISCLOSURE filing record.  Distinct from ``filing`` (financial-statement forms) so the financial table stays clean.  ``subject_cik`` is the issuer the disclosure is about — a SOFT reference (LEFT JOIN to entity.cik when in the fundamentals universe; may be NULL/unmatched for foreign / pre-IPO / delisted issuers).  ``filer_party_id`` FKs to ``insider_party`` (the insider / holder).  Children ``insider_transaction`` and ``insider_ownership`` FK to this table via accession_id.  FULL bucket only — enterprise tier.

accession_id.description: Unique SEC accession ID for this disclosure filing.

subject_cik.description: Issuer CIK the disclosure is about — soft reference (LEFT JOIN to entity.cik; no hard FK).

filer_party_id.description: FK to the insider / holder in insider_party (NULL when unresolved).

filer_cik.description: Denormalised filer CIK for query convenience.

insider_transaction.description: Form 3 / 4 / 5 / 144 line items — each row is one transaction, initial holding, or proposed sale by an insider.  transaction_type is 'transaction' (Form 4/5), 'initial_holding' (Form 3), or 'proposed_sale' (Form 144).  Joins to ``insider_filing`` via accession_id, to ``entity`` (issuer) via entity_id (soft ref), and to ``insider_party`` via insider_party_id.  FULL bucket only.

entity_id.description: Issuer CIK (the company whose securities the insider holds).  Soft reference — LEFT JOIN to entity.cik when the issuer is in the fundamentals universe; may not resolve for foreign / pre-IPO / delisted issuers.

aggregate_market_value.description: Form 144 only — proposed-sale total dollar value.

insider_name.description: DENORMALIZED from insider_party.name (LEFT JOIN on insider_party_id at export). Inlined so the MCP Worker resolves the reporting insider's name from this tiny per-CIK partition without decoding the 406K-row insider_party dimension (the CF 1102 OOM). NULL if the party_id has no dimension match.

institutional_filing.description: Form 13F-HR / 13F-NT (and amendments) — the manager-rooted filing record.  Distinct from ``filing`` (issuer-rooted) because 13F filings have no single subject issuer (the manager reports a portfolio across many issuers).  FK to ``insider_party`` for the manager.  FULL bucket only — enterprise tier.

accession_id.description: Unique SEC accession ID for this 13F filing.

filer_party_id.description: FK to the manager's row in insider_party.

filer_cik.description: Denormalised manager CIK — mirrors institutional_holding.filer_cik for query convenience.

institutional_holding.description: Form 13F-HR holdings — institutional managers' quarterly position disclosures.  One row per (filing, CUSIP, share-class, put/call).  Joins to ``institutional_filing`` via accession_id (the 13F filing record); ``filer_cik`` is the manager CIK (denormalised — same value as institutional_filing.filer_cik). ``subject_entity_id`` is the issuer CIK (NULL until the CUSIP→CIK lookup resolves).  FULL bucket only — enterprise tier.

filer_cik.description: Manager CIK (denormalised from institutional_filing.filer_cik for query convenience).

filer_name.description: DENORMALIZED 13F manager name (LEFT JOIN insider_party on filer_cik = cik at export time). Lets consumers render the holder name without decoding the insider_party dimension. NULL only when the manager CIK is unresolved.

subject_entity_id.description: Resolved issuer CIK; NULL until CUSIP→CIK lookup completes.

put_call.description: PUT | CALL | NULL (NULL = common stock, not an option).

investment_discretion.description: SOLE | DFND | OTR (Form 13F bulk vocabulary) or SOLE | SHARED | NONE (per-filing XML vocabulary).

insider_ownership.description: SC 13D / SC 13G beneficial-ownership disclosures (5%+ stakes).  One row per (filing, reporting person).  Group filings carry multiple reporting persons — each lands as a separate row.  Joins to ``insider_filing`` via accession_id; subject_entity_id is the issuer CIK (the company being held — soft ref, LEFT JOIN to entity).  FULL bucket only — enterprise tier (full plan).

filer_cik.description: Reporting-person CIK; NULL when not SEC-registered (many institutional disclosures only carry a name).

filer_party_id.description: FK into ``insider_party`` for the reporting person.  Resolved at merge time from the cover-page filer name via normalized_name match.  Use this column for cross-filing roll-ups ("every disclosure by this filer over time"); ``filer_name`` stays as the verbatim cover-page text for display.

subject_entity_id.description: Issuer CIK — the company whose stock is held.  Soft reference — LEFT JOIN to entity.cik when in the fundamentals universe.

schedule_type.description: SC 13D | SC 13D/A | SC 13G | SC 13G/A (or SCHEDULE 13… long-form variants — both vocabularies accepted).
